productionBriefs.down_getup: Use case: identity-preserve. Game asset SOURCE sheet: exactly NINE COMPLETE Goku pixel-art poses in3columns x3rows, genuine transparent alpha. Input is strict approved design/style: same recognizable face, black spiky hair volume, athletic anatomy, orange gi, navy shirt/sash/wristbands, blue boots with red trim/gold bands. Native130px anime/MUGEN fighting-game pixel art enlarged nearest-neighbor, clean stepped dark contours, limited colors/angular shading; no smooth illustration, antialiasing, blur, gradients or3D. All faceRIGHT, torso3/4, same head/limb/boot size and anatomical scale in every cel. FIRST CELL canonical neutral standing guard for calibration. Other poses change height only by joint flexion/foreshortening. Entire hair/head/neck, both arms/hands, attached belt/gi, both coherent thighs/knees/calves/boots must fit completely with generous blank margin in each evenly spaced cell. No cropped, amputated, disconnected, melted or stretched limbs. Each is a new COMPLETE anatomical drawing, not a deformed source or collage. No weapon, effects, shadows, floor, background, text or labels. Martial energy, stable support foot, real shoulder/hip rotation and clear preparation/impact/recovery. Sheet KNOCKDOWN, GETUP AND KO, full coherent drawings. After standing calibration:2falls onto one bracing hand and hip, knees bending;3rolls onto side with both legs and boots complete;4settled down lying sideways on ground, head/face visible and legs naturally bent;5same KO lying pose settles subtly with relaxed hand/hair;6pushes from ground with palm and hip, begins rising;7kneels on one knee and plants other foot;8rises through balanced half squat using legs;9nearly canonical upright combat guard. Same anatomical scale; lying pose may be wide but MUST fit fully with generous margin, never clipped. No folded/vanishing calves, extra arms, gore or effects. No weapon. All ground contact at consistent local floor. KO looks defeated, not asleep smiling.
